SignBridge Capture
Gesture dataset collection

Thank you for taking part

You are helping build a gesture dataset for sign and gesture recognition research. You will perform 33 short hand gestures, and each one is photographed 3 times: at the start, the peak and the end. The session takes about 40 minutes, with a break in the middle. Take your time, and there is no need to be perfect.

Unfinished session found

A few things that help a lot

  • Use a phone with a working camera, prop it on something steady in landscape, and keep it still.
  • Please keep your face out of the picture. The top edge of the frame should sit at your collarbone. For Eat, Drink and Water the hand is near the face, so you may tilt the phone up to fit your hand. Your face may then appear, but you never have to show it.
  • Wear a plain solid dark top with no print. Remove watches, bracelets, threads and rings.
  • Use a plain wall behind you and even light. Avoid a window or lamp that changes the light on your hands.
  • Keep both hands fully inside the frame at the peak of every gesture.

About you and your setup

Your privacy: please keep your face out of the pictures except where the page says it is allowed, and know that your photos stay on your phone until you tap Send at the end. Nothing is uploaded before that.

Time for a short break

Stretch your hands and shoulders and drink some water. When you come back, keep the phone and your seat in the same place so the framing does not change. Your progress is saved on this phone.

All done, thank you

Your contribution makes this research possible. Please download the zip and send it to the organiser by Google Drive or email. Avoid WhatsApp, because it compresses images and spoils the quality.

Send your photos to the organiser

Tap the button and keep this page open until it says sent. It can take a few minutes. If it stops, tap again and it carries on where it stopped.
